name: YTS Torrents
description: Adds a dashboard page to search YTS for movies, send a chosen torrent release to an external qBittorrent instance, and automatically import the finished file into a Jellyfin library folder once the download completes, triggering a library scan.
overview: Search YTS and download movies straight into your Jellyfin library via qBittorrent.

versions.changelog: Fix scheduled downloads polling task waiting up to an hour before its first run after startup. Import subtitle files alongside the video. Log a warning (and eventually mark the download failed) when a tracked torrent goes missing from qBittorrent instead of failing silently. Add progress logging for the polling task. Add a qBittorrent connection test button, sidebar navigation entries, and live download/seeding progress and status in the dashboard page. Restructure the dashboard page so Search opens a modal instead of an inline form. Show a proper plugin icon and version number, and fix the plugin category.
First release. Search YTS from a dashboard page, send releases to qBittorrent, and automatically import finished downloads into a library folder.
